method: Rows 1-15 of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv in file order. The file held 29 missed cases, all cve-pairs-php (no Python, no JavaScript), and none of these 15 had been noted by an earlier run. For each case I read the fix commit's message and full per-file diff (gh api repos/O/R/commits/SHA) and, where the diff did not show the source or the sink, the files at the fix commit's parent (gh api repos/O/R/contents/PATH?ref=PARENT, raw): pimcore's CustomReportController, adminer's sql.inc.php and include/functions.inc.php, revive's al.php, subrion's ia.core.users.php, Dolibarr's notice.php, phpipam's item-add-submit.php and functions/classes/class.Common.php, LimeSurvey's statistics_helper.php, participantsaction.php and models/Participant.php, intelmq-manager's controller.php, LimeSurveyFileManager.php and globalSettings_view.php, ILIAS's ilPRGAssignmentFilter.php, ilStudyProgrammeMembersTableGUI.php, RegistrationCodeRepository.php and RegistrationCodesTable.php, roundcube's rcmail_action.php and rcube_imap_generic.php, and freescout's LogViewerController.php and LaravelLogViewer.php. Nothing was skipped. 14 cases are left in the file.

notes.sink: bundles/AdminBundle/Controller/Reports/CustomReportController.php:454 new BinaryFileResponse($exportFile); then :457 deleteFileAfterSend(true) (Symfony streams the file at that path and deletes it)
notes.between: downloadCsvAction() takes the query parameter straight into the response object; createCsvAction() (:415-420) appends to whatever path the same parameter names, so the same value also steers a write. No fopen/readfile in the diff: the read and the unlink happen inside Symfony's BinaryFileResponse, which a scanner may not treat as a file sink. The fix prefixes PIMCORE_SYSTEM_TEMP_DIRECTORY and wraps the value in basename() (:454) and returns basename($exportFile) at :436.
notes.fix: prefixes the temp directory and takes basename() of exportFile before BinaryFileResponse
notes.probe:
<?php

notes.source: adminer/sql.inc.php:225 remove_from_uri("sql|limit|error_stops|only_errors") -> adminer/include/functions.inc.php:736 remove_from_uri() -> :728 relative_uri() -> $_SERVER["REQUEST_URI"] (the raw request URI, not a $_GET access)
notes.sink: adminer/sql.inc.php:225 the helper's result is concatenated into a single-quoted JavaScript argument and printed by script() (include/functions.inc.php:123-125 returns "<script>$source</script>")
notes.between: remove_from_uri() removes only the named query parameters from the URI and returns the rest unchanged; the value is embedded in "qs('#form').onsubmit = partial(sqlSubmit, qs('#form'), '<uri>');" and echoed, so a quote or newline in the URI breaks out of the JavaScript string. The fix wraps the helper in js_escape() (functions.inc.php:296, addcslashes) and also strips the history parameter.
notes.fix: escapes remove_from_uri() output with js_escape() before it goes into the script block
notes.probe:
<?php
function relative_uri() {
    return preg_replace('~^[^?]*/([^?]*)~', '\1', $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI']);
}
function remove_from_uri($param = '') {
    return substr(preg_replace("~(?<=[?&])($param)=[^&]*&", '', relative_uri() . '&'), 0, -1);
}
function script($source) {
    return "<script>$source</script>";
}
echo script("qs('#form').onsubmit = partial(sqlSubmit, qs('#form'), '" . remove_from_uri('sql|limit') . "');");

notes.source: includes/classes/ia.core.users.php:707-709 $s = unserialize($_COOKIE['salt']); (the salt cookie, read inside a protected method of the users class)
notes.sink: includes/classes/ia.core.users.php:709 unserialize() on the cookie value (PHP object injection, later code execution through magic methods)
notes.between: _getSalt() reads $_COOKIE directly and only inspects $s['salt'] and $s['items'] after the call; no request handler shows the cookie on its way there. The fix replaces the call with json_decode($_COOKIE['salt'], true).
notes.probe:
<?php
class Users
{
    protected function getSalt()
    {
        $salt = array();
        if (isset($_COOKIE['salt']) && $_COOKIE['salt']) {
            $s = unserialize($_COOKIE['salt']);
            if (isset($s['salt']) && $s['salt']) {
                $salt = $s;
            }
        }
        return $salt;
    }
}

notes.source: application/helpers/admin/statistics_helper.php:325-326 for (reset($_POST); $key = key($_POST); next($_POST)) { $postvars[] = $key; } - the POST *keys* become SQL column names
notes.sink: application/helpers/admin/statistics_helper.php:373 $thisquestion = Yii::app()->db->quoteColumnName($pv) . " IN ("; and the other quoteColumnName() calls at :415, :420, :428, :433, :440, :443, :458, :461, :472, :478 inside buildSelects()
notes.between: each POST key is turned into an SQL identifier; quoteColumnName() adds identifier quotes but does not escape quoting characters, so a key carrying a backtick and SQL breaks out of the IN()/comparison. The fix builds $validColumns from the response table schema and replaces every quoteColumnName() with a $quoteColumn closure that throws for unknown columns, wrapped in try/catch. userstatistics_helper.php gets the same change.
notes.fix: allowlists POST keys against the response-table columns before quoting them
notes.probe:
<?php
function buildSelects($postvars)
{
    $selects = array();
    foreach ($postvars as $pv) {
        if (is_array($_POST[$pv])) {
            $selects[] = Yii::app()->db->quoteColumnName($pv) . " IN ("
                . implode(',', array_map('intval', $_POST[$pv])) . ")";
        }
    }
    return implode(' AND ', $selects);
}
$postvars = array_keys($_POST);
$where = buildSelects($postvars);
$rows = Yii::app()->db->createCommand('SELECT * FROM responses WHERE ' . $where)->queryAll();

notes.source: application/controllers/admin/LimeSurveyFileManager.php:398 public function getZipFile($path) - Yii binds the action's $path argument from the request (?path=...)
notes.between: the path is only passed through basename() for the download name; :406 guards the read with if (is_file($path) || true), which is always true, so any path is read and then deleted. No request read appears in the method: the value arrives as an action parameter. The fix stops passing the path in the URL, stores it in $_SESSION['__path'] and checks a real is_file().
notes.fix: keeps the zip path in the session and requires is_file() instead of 'is_file($path) || true'
notes.probe:
<?php
class LimeSurveyFileManager extends CAction
{
    public function getZipFile($path)
    {
        $filename = basename($path);
        if (is_file($path) || true) {
            header('Content-Type: application/zip');
            header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . $filename . '"');
            @readfile($path);
            unlink($path);
        }
    }
}

<?php
class AssignmentFilter
{
    protected array $values = [];

    public function withValues(array $values): self
    {
        $this->values = $values;

    public function toConditions(): array
    {

<?php
class LogViewer
{
    protected $folder;

    public function setFolder($folder)
    {
        $this->folder = $folder;
    }

    public function pathToLogFile($file)
    {
        $logsPath = storage_path('logs');
        $logsPath .= ($this->folder) ? '/' . $this->folder : '';
        return $logsPath . '/' . $file;
    }

    public function read($file)
    {
        return app('files')->get($this->pathToLogFile($file));
    }
}
$viewer = new LogViewer();
$viewer->setFolder(Crypt::decrypt($request->input('f')));
